about: local contests of 2026 in North Carolina, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_ncsbe.py from pipeline/intake/ncsbe.py's cache.

party_codes.other codes: the source's own three-letter code, in party and party_code; its layout files give no codebook

ncsbe.name: North Carolina State Board of Elections, precinct results by contest (results_pct files of the public download site's ENRS folder)
ncsbe.licence: public records under N.C. Gen. Stat. 132-1, as the site's ReadMe_PUBLIC_DATA.txt says; no licence printed
ncsbe.note: the state's own certified counts, by county, precinct and choice, added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/ncsbe.py; files read: 2026-03-03 (results_pct_20260303.zip, sha256 d5450bfad838)

fips.name: county FIPS codes: the county_name and county_fips columns of MEDSL's 2024 North Carolina precinct file

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used
